prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
**[goal]** A 3D low-poly wallpaper that instantly reads as Hokusai's Great Wave off Kanagawa, with recorded provenance.

**[action]**
- Read ./print.jpg visually: confirmed the cartouche 冨嶽三十六景 神奈川沖浪裏 (Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji: The Great Wave), counted **3 boats** (lower left under the crest, center trough, right slope), mountain **Mount Fuji** (冨嶽, Fugaku) small on the horizon.
- Wrote `./scene/index.html`: single file, three.js r170 from the whitelisted jsdelivr URL, no build step. The wave is rebuilt in code as an extruded iconic silhouette (dark Prussian-blue mass, curling crest with claw fingers, foam blobs, spray), plus extruded sea with mound and right swell, Mount Fuji cone, 3 ochre oshiokuri-bune with rowers, gray smoke band, clouds. Palette sampled from the print (#1b4d7a, #4e83b4, #a9c4d9, #f7f3e6, #f2ead4, #e3b48a...). Gentle motion: wave sway, claw/bob drift, boats bobbing, rowers rowing, slow camera drift.
- Wrote `./result.json` recording boats (count 3) and mountain (Mount Fuji) plus palette and assumptions.
- Iterated 3 times in the live browser: fixed wave geometry (thin arch → extruded silhouette), camera scale, Fuji size, and boat placement (two were buried inside geometry).

**[result]** Verified by opening the file in a browser: screenshot shows the recognizable composition (dominant curling wave left with foam claws, 3 boats, Fuji at horizon right, cream sky). Browser tab closed; no other processes started.

**[next]** None required. Assumptions stated in result.json: 3 boats in this impression (some impressions show a distant 4th, not visible in ./print.jpg); print used only as visual reference, no texture.
